gap.question: What are the measured physiological concentrations of inosine and SCFAs inside the human tumour microenvironment correlating with ICI response?
success_criteria: Identify prospective human studies reporting absolute concentrations (e.g., μmol/g or μM) of inosine or specific SCFAs in paired tumor tissue and serum/stool from ICI-treated solid tumor patients.
